LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Settings.DebugLoggingD: Write detailed Wardrobe Attendant diagnostics to the RimWorld log.
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Window.Title: Wardrobe assignments: {0}
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Slot.LockedDesc: Wardrobe Attendant will lock this apparel after equipping it. This prevents the mod from racing vanilla self-equipping. Only the player or a Wardrobe Attendant worker can unlock or remove it.
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Slot.RemoveAtThreshold: If no compatible replacement is available, a worker will remove apparel that falls below the durability threshold.
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Settings.PreventVanill: Prevent vanilla self-equipping of apparel that Wardrobe Attendant is set to remove

When enabled, vanilla self-equipping will not select an apparel item that an enabled Wardrobe Attendant rule is set to remove after its durability threshold. Vanilla apparel selection remains enabled for other items.
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Settings.SkipDraftedTa: When enabled, drafted colonists will not be selected as targets for new Wardrobe Attendant dressing or apparel removal jobs. Already active Wardrobe Attendant jobs targeting a drafted colonist are interrupted before equipment is changed.
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Slot.DuplicateFullOutf: Only one Full outfit slot can be active. This slot has been deactivated.
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Slot.DuplicateExactIte: Only one Exact item slot for this apparel can be active. This slot has been deactivated.
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Slot.AllowSelfService: Allow this colonist to service their own wardrobe
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Slot.AllowSelfServiceD: When disabled, this apparel slot will not be serviced by the pawn who owns it.
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Slot.AllowEarlyReplace: Allow replacing current apparel before its durability threshold
When enabled, a better available candidate can replace current apparel before it falls below the durability threshold. Requires a score advantage of at least 10.
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Slot.AllowWorkerRemove: Allow Wardrobe Attendant workers to remove locked apparel
When enabled, a Wardrobe Attendant worker may remove or replace this locked apparel. When disabled, only the player can remove it.
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Slot.UseProtectionPrio: Vacuum protection and toxicity protection receive increased priority.
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Settings.ResetWindowPo: Restores the default size and position of Wardrobe Attendant windows. Windows will use the default placement until they are moved and closed again.
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Settings.WindowPositio: The position and size of all mod windows have been reset.
LanguageData.WardrobeAttendant.Slot.ExactDefUnwearabl: This slot is considered unfulfillable and will not be serviced: the selected item cannot be worn by this pawn.
